name: Her Name Is Olgra

faq.answer: Olgra fell in battle against the quilboar. While the healer who aided Mankrik managed to save him, she could not be rescued, and Mankrik intends to honor her memory forever.

aliases: what are the adornments made of
faq.answer: Her adornments are cherished pieces of crafted jewelry made from polished bone, which she wore before she was slain.
The ornaments were taken from Olgra's fallen form, prompting Mankrik to send you against the Razormane raiders near the place where she died to recover them.
faq.q: Why are the Razormane raiders being hunted?

aliases: what will mankrik do with the adornments
why does mankrik want the adornments
faq.answer: Mankrik plans to place the recovered bone jewelry alongside a monument he is constructing in Olgra's honour so that her memory never fades.
faq.q: What will Mankrik do with the recovered adornments?

sections.body: Though a healer managed to save Mankrik, Olgra succumbed to her wounds on the battlefield. Determined that her name and sacrifice will never be forgotten, the grieving warrior prepares to construct a lasting tribute to honor her memory.
sections.title: Honoring the Fallen

sections.body: Olgra wore cherished ornaments of polished bone, but they were missing from her resting place. Mankrik seeks to recover these personal treasures from the nearby Razormane raiders so they can rest beside the monument he is raising for her.
sections.title: Lost Keepsakes

summary: After learning of Olgra's death in battle, Mankrik resolves to honor her with a lasting memorial. He asks you to recover her missing bone adornments from the nearby Razormane raiders so they may rest beside her monument.
attribution: In-game quest text: Her Name Is Olgra
